Application Insights View Requirements Education Responsibilities & Context BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh that partners with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty globally to create sustainable opportunities to realise potential. Working at BRAC is not like any other job. It is a platform where you can bring about real change for people who need it the most. We are not just dreaming of a better world, we are building it. Join us to find the way. Project Brief: The "Unlocking Financial Solutions for Youth Enterprise Development" / "Access to Capital and Entrepreneurial Skills for Success (ACCESS)" Project aims to support youth entrepreneurs in Bangladesh by improving their access to financial resources and strengthening their entrepreneurial capabilities. Implemented by BRAC in collaboration with Education Above All, the project focuses on addressing the limited access to conventional financial resources faced by youth (aged 18–35) who aspire to develop or expand their income-generating ventures. Through this initiative, BRAC will extend loans to these young entrepreneurs to improve the economic well-being of both the youths and their households. Additionally, the project will provide financial literacy, entrepreneurship skills training, and mentorship support to young entrepreneurs to enhance their ventures' sustainability. The project end date is 30 September 2026. We are inviting applications from the interested candidates for the following position to implement the project. Job Purpose: The person will be responsible for ensuring the effective field-level implementation of project activities by coordinating and managing the field team and maintaining strong collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. The role supports the Head Office in implementing programme interventions, facilitating local-level trainings and meetings, and ensuring timely financial and technical reporting. Additionally, the position promotes and upholds safeguarding standards, ensuring a safe and supportive environment for programme participants, stakeholders, and team members. Key Responsibilities: Implement field-level execution plans to ensure the timely and smooth delivery of project activities.
